map.设定生成数量后，工具按租赁物类型与期限组合出若干条条款要点（如\"月租金 ___: After setting the generation count, the tool produces several clause points by property type and term combination (e.g. "monthly rent ____ CNY, payable before the ____ day each month", "deposit ____ months rent, refunded within ____ days after move-out inspection", "the property main structure and natural wear are maintained by Party A, damage caused by Party B improper use is borne by Party B"); the underlined parts are placeholders to fill. Fill the placeholders with actual numbers and dates to use as a draft.
map.生成的文本能直接当合同用吗？: Can the generated text be used directly as a contract?
map.不能。它是条款要点与填空模板，用于起草和查漏，不构成法律意见。正式合同建议结合当: No. It is clause points and a fill-in template, for drafting and gap-checking, not legal advice. For a formal contract, use the model text of the local housing department; for significant value, consult a lawyer.
map.为什么每次生成的内容不完全一样？: Why is the generated content not exactly the same each time?
